name: Abu Zakariya
note: emir; title al-Muntahab li-Ihya Din-Allah (work list: Abu Zakariya Yahya)

name: Abu-l Baqa Khalid An-Nasr
note: son of Abu Zakariya; took Tunis 1309, reuniting Hafsid lands; assassinated

name: Abu Yahya Abu Bakr
note: entered Tunis early 1318, reuniting the Hafsid domains (Béjaïa no longer separate)

name: Abu Abdullah ibn Abu Zakaria
note: second period of independence: received Béjaïa from Abu Ishaq Ibrahim II (start not given); lost Béjaïa to Abu'l Abbas in May 1366

name: Abu'l Abbas
note: of Constantine; took Béjaïa May 1366, reunited western and eastern domains 1370

name: Abu-l-Hasan Ali
note: third period: governor appointed by al-Muntasir, rebelled spring 1436; Uthman's troops captured Béjaïa 9 November 1439; insurgency until his execution 1452

name: Abul-Abbas Abd al-Aziz
note: emir in the early 16th century, independent of Tunis; Spanish capture of Béjaïa 1510 ended the emirate
